$comment: Approved DIRECT dependencies. Activate with --approved=<this file> or by copying the 'approved' array into <repo>/.deps-policy.json. Scope: --approval-scope=new (default) gates only direct dep names new vs the git baseline; 'all' gates the whole tree (audit/deploy). approvedBy + date are the sign-off; blank = a pending request (still blocking). rationale + reviewBy are required under --strict/--frozen. Name-level by default; add "version"/"versions" to require a fresh approval on bump. Bootstrap once locally with --seed-approved (never in CI); seeded entries carry grandfathered:true and need a real review. Full process: references/approval-workflow.md.
